AI: 10 proof points

What is your AI experience?

source: Tom's own account

I've been hands-on with AI/ML across multiple roles:

At Novo, I built a GenAI proof of concept for automating compliance reviews - a RAG model that could auto-document submissions and a Figma agent for shift-left design validation.

At LEO, I led a machine learning team building a skin diagnosis app.

I also built a weight-loss prediction algorithm at Novo - hands-on work with clinical data that later became an API product.

Right now I'm building with Claude Code, GitHub and Netlify. This chatbot is one of those projects.

I'm not a specialist engineer. My value is in understanding enough to ask the right questions, spot opportunities, and bridge between technical and commercial.

Want to know more about any of these projects? Just ask.

What growth experience do you have?

Solo projects, building with AI

source: Tom's own account

Solo projects, building with AI (2026).

I learn by doing, and I love building. So I shipped three products with AI to find out first-hand what it can and can't do.

The task I set myself: build something real with AI and ship it.

  • TomBot: a prototype AI trained on my CV. Built with Claude API, RAG vector store, eval suite & guard-rails. Live January 2026 at takenbyninjas.com/projects/tombot/
  • kittenpm.com: a product training SIM inspired by Lemmings. Practice balancing product trade-offs in real time. Built with React, TypeScript & Phaser. Used Claude as my engineering team. Live July 2026.
  • deathspiralorgoldenage.org: Will AI cut jobs or create new work? A public poll, live sentiment tracker, and open economic model with CC0 data. Researched & built with AI. Live September 2026.
